features.text: LG SideKick™ for small loads that are big deal

The compact LG Sidekick™ is specially designed for your small, custom-care laundry loads. So you can clean three days of sweat-laden spin class gear now rather than waiting for a full load in your regular washer.

Grab the multi-function remote control to start, stop or select a cycle on your LG Sidekick™ washer from the comfort of your favorite chair. Plus, it's magnetic, so you can attach it to the side of your washer, dryer or other metal surface to ensure it doesn't get lost in the daily shuffle.

With special cycles for Intimates, Hand Wash and Active Wear, each setting is designed to deliver a thorough clean and proper fabric care for items you prefer to wash separately. There's even a convenient TubClean Cycle to keep your LG SideKick™ fresh, clean and in tip-top condition.
